ctx.x: Well, Mr. Cortez and Pisarro took good care of that when they brought with them... You must remember, when the Bible was written, they didn't know anything about this side of the world.

We've got a good (?) to go. You don't really want to say anything more about Bebop. But the pianists like... For instance, at the beginning of the Forties Eddie Heywood came on the scene. He had a big influence.
